limitations: Synthetic-fixture evaluation only. These numbers do not prove real-world detection accuracy; they show which layer combination separates the fixture's labelled motifs from its labelled near-miss negatives. Every feature is strictly causal (only facts at or before its own transaction's timestamp), proved by the truncation property tests in tests/unit/test_anomaly_stack.py. The `motif` task's labels are close to the deterministic rule's own predicate, so its margin overstates what a model adds; `discrimination` is the honest comparison.
